summary: SliceVec::drain adds 1 to excluded start bounds and included end bounds. At usize::MAX, this overflows: checked arithmetic panics, while unchecked arithmetic wraps to zero and can accept an invalid range. The fix uses saturating_add(1), preserving a large bound for the existing range checks to reject. The implementation reversal is exact and unique, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision: the fix adds a honggfuzz target, while existing tests and SliceVec doctests do not exercise these extreme bounds. Blocked pending an eligible existing regression test; no builds or tests were run.
